(6) For provision conferring additional powers to enter and search vessels and
aircraft, see section 39.

39 Power to enter and search premises

(1) Where a justice is satisfied that the requirements in subsection (4) are met in
relation to any premises, the justice may issue a warrant (a “search warrant”)
authorising a relevant enforcement officer—
(a) to enter the premises, and
(b) to search them for relevant evidence.

(2) A search warrant may be issu ed only on the application of—
(a) a relevant enforcement officer, in England and Wales or Northern
Ireland;
(b) a relevant enforcement officer or a procurator fiscal, in Scotland.
